properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (item 12 of req:small-read-back-faults-from-the-cogito-trial-are-fixed; budget.rs, closure.rs, inference.rs constraint_truth): direction `setpoint` (a test parameter such as "carrier 9.4 GHz"): budget_report reads it ungated, the closure budgets leg skips it, and it holds as a value, never exceeded. add_constraint takes `source`, stored on the Constraint. A limit with no direction still reads as a maximum.
properties.name: A constraint can be a setpoint — a value held, never a budget — and name its source
